prompt:
Write a first-person account (about 120 words) by the driver for an insurance claim form. Accident: side impact at intersection in Pearland, Texas. Injury: concussion. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1370; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The claimant later added small details, but the account stayed the same.
- The driver is named on the policy.
text: I was driving through the intersection in Pearland, Texas, when a vehicle coming from my right failed to stop and struck the side of my car. The impact spun my vehicle partway around and pushed it toward the curb. I remember the airbags deploying and a sharp ringing in my head, and I was dizzy and confused when I got out to check on the other driver. Paramedics later diagnosed a concussion. Since giving my first statement at the scene, I have remembered a few more small details, such as the color of the other car's headlights, but the core account of what happened has not changed. I am the named driver on this policy and I am submitting this statement so the claim can be reviewed.
